kind.value: AI content tool with cross-posting, a social media API and an MCP server

hosting.value: Hosted (no self-host option on its pricing page)

pricingModel.value: Flat monthly plans by connected accounts, each with a monthly allowance of AI credits

freeOption.value: No free plan; a 7-day trial instead

trial.value: 7-day free trial; a card is required. The trial covers the web app but not the API or MCP server, and creating an API key ends the trial and starts the paid plan

plans.value: Starter $29 (20 accounts, 1,250 AI credits), Creator $97 (40 accounts, 5,000 credits), Agency $499 (28,000 credits)

networks.value: 9: X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky and Pinterest

api.value: Social media API on every paid plan, not during the trial; official n8n and Make nodes

mcp.value: Hosted MCP server with 35 tools on every paid plan, not during the trial

ai.value: Unlimited AI writing; AI images and videos from monthly credits (1,250 on Starter); AI voiceovers and captions
